title: A simple phenol-free isolation method for high-quality RNA from bilberry
author: Wang, Liu, et al.

steps.title: Collect and freeze bilberry tissue
steps.instruction: Harvest bilberry fruits, separate pulp and peel, immediately place them in liquid nitrogen and store at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Mill frozen pulp and peel
steps.instruction: Weigh approximately 100 mg of frozen pulp or peel per replicate (three replicates per tissue), place each sample in a 2 mL Eppendorf tube with a 5 mm sterile steel ball, and mill for 60 s at 22 Hz using a Mixer Mill MM400.

steps.title: Lyse tissue with CTAB and DTT
steps.instruction: To each ~80 mg powdered sample add 900 µL pre‑heated CTAB buffer (65 °C) and 9 µL DTT (1 M), vortex for 3 s, then incubate 20 min at 65 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm in a Thermomixer.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the tubes at 11,000 rpm (g) for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Chloroform:IAA extraction
steps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube and extract twice with an equal volume of chloroform:IAA (24:1); after each addition mix gently and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 10 min at room temperature to separate phases.

steps.title: LiCl precipitation overnight
steps.instruction: Add ¼ volume of 10 M LiCl (42.4 g mol⁻¹) to the pooled supernatant, mix gently, and let the RNA precipitate overnight at +4 °C.

steps.title: Pellet centrifugation at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13,000 rpm for 20 min at +4 °C and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of RNA pellet
steps.instruction: Wash the RNA pellet with 500 µL cold 70 % ethanol, centrifuge for 5 min, then decant the ethanol.

steps.title: Resuspend RNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Dissolve the washed RNA pellet in 100 µL TE buffer.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation and final resuspension
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL cold 100 % ethanol, centrifuge for 5 min, discard the ethanol, and finally dissolve the RNA pellet in 20 µL TE buffer.

steps.title: Quantify and assess RNA quality
steps.instruction: Measure total RNA concentration with a NanoDrop 2000C and evaluate RNA integrity (RIN) using an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer according to the manufacturers’ instructions.
